title: New Jersey Smart Thermostat Rebates 2026: Free to $150
desc: New Jersey smart thermostat rebates in 2026: PSE&G offers up to $100 or a free one, JCP&L $100, and Atlantic City Electric $150 plus up to $100 a year for Energy Wise Rewards.
h1: New Jersey Smart Thermostat Rebates in 2026
lead: A smart thermostat is the cheapest upgrade in this whole guide, and New Jersey utilities lower the price a lot. PSE&G can install one for free. JCP&L pays $100. Atlantic City Electric pays $150 for a limited time and up to $100 a year for joining a program that trims power use on hot days. Here is what we read on October 6, 2026.
cards_intro: Each card names the fact we keep on file, with the date we last read the official page.

cards.title: PSE&G
cards.note: Up to $100 as a post-purchase rebate, $60 when installed with a heating or cooling job, or a free ENERGY STAR smart thermostat during a Whole Home Energy Assessment. The marketplace sells ecobee and Google Nest models with instant discounts.

cards.title: JCP&L
cards.note: Per ENERGY STAR smart thermostat, for equipment bought and installed January 1, 2025 through June 30, 2027. Apply within 120 days.

cards.title: Atlantic City Electric
cards.note: For an ENERGY STAR smart thermostat installed with an HVAC job, for a limited time through June 30, 2027.

cards.title: Energy Wise Rewards
cards.note: Atlantic City Electric pays you for letting it ease your thermostat when demand is high. You need an eligible smart thermostat.

cards.title: Comfort Partners
cards.note: Thermostats are among the free measures for households at or below 250% of the federal poverty level.

after_cards: Check each page's rules about which thermostat models qualify before you buy. The programs list approved products, and a model that is not on the list earns nothing.
sections: If PSE&G is your utility, book the Whole Home Energy Assessment before you buy anything. The visit takes about an hour, and PSE&G can install an ENERGY STAR smart thermostat at no cost, with other small products such as LED bulbs and door sweeps while supplies last. If your income is low, Comfort Partners and PSE&G Home Weatherization can include a thermostat too.
What a smart thermostat does for savings

It lets you set a schedule once and change it from your phone. The savings come from heating and cooling less when no one is home. It does nothing for a house that leaks air through the attic, which is why weatherization comes first in many homes. See our weatherization guide.

A heat pump works best with a thermostat that knows how to run it. Utilities pay for a thermostat as part of the same job: PSE&G lists $60 with an install and Atlantic City Electric lists $150 with an HVAC job. Ask your contractor to include the thermostat on the same invoice so the rebate is applied for you.

Pick a model that is on your utility's approved list and works with your heating and cooling system. A heat pump with a backup heater needs a thermostat that can control both stages, so tell the seller exactly what is in your home before you buy. If you rent, ask your landlord before you replace a thermostat, and keep the old one to put back when you move.

A thermostat can also earn money by joining a demand program. Atlantic City Electric's Energy Wise Rewards pays up to $100. PSE&G has programs called FlexPower and SmartFlex, which we did not read in detail. Read the fine print about how much control the utility gets, and how to opt out of an event.
claim_heading: How to get a smart thermostat rebate
claim_steps: Find your utility on your electric bill.
If it is PSE&G, ask for a free Whole Home Energy Assessment first.
Otherwise buy an ENERGY STAR smart thermostat from the approved list.
Apply within the window: 120 days for JCP&L and PSE&G post-purchase rebates.
Keep the receipt and model number.
faq: Can I get a free smart thermostat in New Jersey?
Yes, from PSE&G during a free Whole Home Energy Assessment, and through Comfort Partners if your income qualifies.
How much does JCP&L pay for a smart thermostat?
Atlantic City Electric pays up to $100 if you enroll an eligible smart thermostat and let it save energy when demand is high.
Do I need a heat pump to get a thermostat rebate?
No. The thermostat rebates stand on their own, though some are bigger when installed with a heating or cooling job.
The pages we read give no end date for PSE&G, give June 30, 2027 for JCP&L and the Atlantic City Electric limited-time $150, and can change without notice.
